EN.body:
Hagah Dabar means "to murmur and meditate (hagah) on the Word (dabar)" (Psalm 1:2).
The app gathers the Bible text, plain explanations, reflection questions and prayers, linked verses and reading plans in one place to help you read and meditate on Scripture every day. Used with the PC app, what you organize on the PC continues on your phone.
EN.title: About Hagah Dabar

KO.body:
Hagah Dabar 는 「말씀(다바르)을 읊조리며 묵상한다(하가)」는 뜻입니다(시편 1:2).
성경 본문과 쉬운 설명, 묵상질문과 기도, 연결된 구절, 묵상플랜을 한자리에 모아 날마다 말씀을 읽고 묵상하도록 돕는 앱입니다. PC 앱과 함께 쓰면 PC 에서 정리한 것을 모바일 폰에서도 볼 수 있습니다.

EN.body:
· Your notes, prayers and AI chats stay on your phone and PC; we do not send them to our server.
· The prayer notebook stays on the phone and is left out of backups.
· When you use AI, your question goes straight to the AI company you chose; Hagah does not receive it.
· AI keys are stored only on that device.
· Usage statistics are sent only with your consent, as anonymous totals.
